decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 5 December 2005, the erection of a front porch, conversion of garage to habitable room and creation of side access door to house was not lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reasons:

The development falls outside the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Classes A and D of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because:

a)	the porch would exceed 3 metres in height and
b)	the conversion of the existing garage to a habitable room is precluded by a condition on the planning consent for the two storey flank extension and it would result in a front extension which is in advance of the bay window line and which exceeds the 70 cubic metres allowance.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a front porch, conversion of garage to habitable room and creation of side access door to house.
